messages.subject: The demographics of Hong Kong R users (n=12)
messages.subject_clean: The demographics of Hong Kong R users (n=12)
messages.body_plain:
I'm Hong and I'm an R enthusiast. I usually use R to slice and dice the data (in programmer's world it is called data munging), conduct some crazy statistical analyses and maybe visualise the data.

In the late February, I posted an online Google Form to collect data on R users who are interested in HKRUG.

So far, 12 users submitted their response.

50% of users describe themselves as "occasional R user", 42% as "experienced R user" and 8% as "R newbie".

100% of users are interested in attending R user group meeting.

messages.body_plain:
As 100% of our member are interested in attending HKRUG meeting, let's organize our 1st meeting in May, shall we?

The history shows that I am a poor organizer. I hope that I can materialize this meeting and I really need your help.

1. Frequency: bimonthly (every two months) or monthly
2. Your preference on weekday / weekend
3. What would you want to do in HKRUG meeting?

Also need your help on the following:

1. Venue, preferable to be free or cheap, with LCD projector
2. Your R expertise, to share your knowledge
3. Any creative ideas

I think I can give a very short talk on data munging or a brief introduction to the data frame.

Thanks

Hong
